headlines.title: Hackers targeted municipal water systems in 7 states this week, FBI says
headlines.description: Cyberattacks targeting municipal water systems have been reported in at least seven states this week, prompting the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency to warn utilities nationwide that hackers are trying to disrupt critical water infrastructure.

headlines.title: Thousands of migrants force their way into Spain’s African territory
headlines.description: Border guards in the tiny Spanish exclave of Ceuta on the Moroccan coast were overwhelmed as crowds of young men pushed through gates and swam around the border barrier, hoping to gain entry into Europe.

headlines.title: Trump administration drops Reflecting Pool case, blaming damage on ‘botched’ installation
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Trump administration has dropped its case against a former Olympic canoeist charged in connection with damage to the Reflecting Pool, acknowledging their allegations against David “Davey” Hearn don’t hold water.

headlines.title: Trump defends ‘anti-weaponization’ fund, further complicating Blanche nomination
headlines.description: President Donald Trump defended his controversial proposal for a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization fund” for Jan. 6 defendants, complicating Todd Blanche’s nomination.

headlines.title: Judge denies request by Elon Musk’s xAI to pause Minnesota nudification ban
headlines.description: A judge denied a request from Elon Musk’s AI company xAI to block Minnesota’s law that will be the first in the nation to ban nudification technology.

headlines.title: Police release Nancy Guthrie ransom notes
headlines.description: Police have released two ransom notes they have received related to the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie. NBC News' Tom Winter reports on the investigation and what authorities could hope to gain by making the notes public.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: WNBA star Brittney Griner files for divorce from wife Cherelle Griner
headlines.description: WNBA star Brittney Griner has filed for divorce after eight years of marriage.

headlines.title: Abortion is on the ballot again in these two states: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: North West cancels music tour days before first show
headlines.description: North West has canceled what would have been her first headlining tour, just months after launching her music career and only days before the first show.

headlines.title: Letters sent to Nancy Guthrie’s family after her disappearance are released
headlines.description: Two ransom notes purportedly sent by those who kidnapped Nancy Guthrie in Arizona earlier this year were released Friday by local authorities hoping to generate new leads in the case.
